function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
function run_out(cmd)
    out = IOBuffer()
    try run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd), stdout = out, stderr = out)) catch e return "ERROR: " * sprint(showerror, e) end
    return String(take!(out))
end
parts = ["sq" => run_out(`squeue -j 2099073,2099074 -o "%.10i %.2t %.10M %C %m %N %R"`), "acct" => run_out(`sacct -j 2099073,2099074 --format=JobID,State,Elapsed,ReqMem,AllocCPUS,NodeList -P`)]
println("{" * join(["$(esc(k)):$(esc(v))" for (k, v) in parts], ",") * "}")
